content:
# ledgerline

Ledgerline is the invoicing and billing servce for Acme. It creates invoices,
computes tax, posts finalized invoices to the external ledger, and exports
monthly reports.

## Layout

- `src/billing/` - money, invoices, refunds, and tax logic
- `src/api/` - the HTTP endpoints
- `migrations/` - the SQL schema migrations
- `scripts/` - operational scripts

## Development

Install the dependancies with `pip install -e .[dev]`, then run the tests.

The tests use pytest, and the `Makefile` has two targets for running them:

```bash
pip install -e .[dev]   # one-time: installs the package and pytest

make test-fast          # pytest -m "not postgres" -q  (skips Postgres-marked tests)
make test               # pytest -q                    (runs the whole suite)
```

Use `make test-fast` for everyday work. Use `make test` when you want everything, including tests that need a Postgres database. No tests in `tests/` currently carry the `postgres` marker, so the two commands run the same tests right now. You can also call pytest yourself, for example `pytest tests/some_test.py -q`.
